_note: Baked by Art/_pxKitBake.js from Art/pxKit.js. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
pivot: bottom-centre of the cell, 2 px up

light.note: fixed upper-left key + back rim, view space (x right · y down · z toward camera), as TreeRig3.LIGHT — the bible's top-of-frame ruling is still open; PxLang.setKey flips every bake

channels.albedo: pre-lit at the fixed key, one band up/down at most
channels._unlit: the authored bands, no directional light
channels._mask: R key N·L · G rim · B height · A coverage
channels._normal: R x · G y-up · B out

species.buttercup: buttercup — a 3 px disc with a dark centre
species.daisy: oxeye daisy — white disc, yellow centre
species.lupin: lupin — a purple spike, paler at the tip
species.fireweed: fireweed — magenta spike, the tall one
species.queenanne: Queen Anne's lace — a flat lacy umbel on stalklets

note: Static, one frame. single = one plant at true height · clump = 3–5 · patch = a low ground drift (lay on grass).
